request: Drive over to the toy car
description: find an object and go to it
tree_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Sequence>
            <Fallback>
                <IsVisible object="toy car" />
                <SearchFor object="toy car" />
            </Fallback>
            <NavigateTo target="toy car" />
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>

request: Fetch the book and hand it to the user
description: find an object, pick it up, and deliver it to the user
tree_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Sequence>
            <Fallback>
                <IsVisible object="book" />
                <SearchFor object="book" />
            </Fallback>
            <NavigateTo target="book" />
            <Grab object="book" />
            <NavigateTo target="user" />
            <Release target="user" />
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>

request: Put the marker at the low shelf within arm reach
description: pick up one object and put it down at another object
tree_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Sequence>
            <Fallback>
                <IsVisible object="marker" />
                <SearchFor object="marker" />
            </Fallback>
            <NavigateTo target="marker" />
            <Grab object="marker" />
            <Fallback>
                <IsVisible object="shelf" />
                <SearchFor object="shelf" />
            </Fallback>
            <NavigateTo target="shelf" />
            <Release target="shelf" />
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>
review_note: Constrained shelf placement to a reachable destination.

request: Greet the visitor near the hallway
description: find a person, look at them, wave, and speak
tree_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Sequence>
            <Fallback>
                <IsVisible object="person" />
                <SearchFor object="person" hint="near the hallway" />
            </Fallback>
            <LookAt target="person" />
            <MoveArm pose="wave" />
            <Say text="Hello!" emotion="happy" />
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>

request: If the plant is in front of you, look at it
description: act only if an object is already visible, without searching or moving
tree_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">

        <Fallback>
            <Sequence>
                <IsVisible object="plant" />
                <LookAt target="plant" />
            </Sequence>
            <Say text="I don't see a plant." emotion="confused" />

    </BehaviorTree>
</root>

request: Try to find the pen, and say so if you can't
description: try to find a pen and report failure; no unrequested navigation
tree_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Fallback>
            <Sequence>
                <Fallback>
                    <IsVisible object="pen" />
                    <SearchFor object="pen" />
                </Fallback>
            </Sequence>
            <Say text="I couldn't find the pen." emotion="sad" />
        </Fallback>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>
review_note: Removed navigation: request only asks to find the pen.

request: Are you next to the shelf?
description: answer a yes/no question about the robot's own state with a condition
tree_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">

        <Fallback>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAt target="shelf" />
                <Say text="Yes, I'm here!" emotion="happy" />
            </Sequence>
            <Say text="Not yet." emotion="curious" />
        </Fallback>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>
